intent: Evaluate whether histogram adaptation improves exterior-to-interior readability without adding fictional light sources or modifying the measured architecture.
baseline: Fresh inner-lighting-audit.json: manual physical ISO100, f8, shutter125, compensation+1. One directional light reported; skylight was outside that audit's LightComponent filter.

pilot.physicalCameraExposure: Keep existing property unchanged; installed Scene.h states it affects only Manual mode
pilot.extendedLuminanceRange: Read live project cvar, never alter it. If legacy mode, MinBrightness=2^0=1 and MaxBrightness=2^16=65536; histogram values remain log2. Extended mode receives EV values directly.

parameterBasis.evBounds: A bounded art-review candidate, not a measured illumination claim: encompasses baseline physical EV about13 and allows darker adaptation while avoiding the full engine extended default -10..20. Lower bound0 and upper16 require interior/exterior visual review; they are not historical lighting values.
parameterBasis.adaptationSpeeds: Installed Scene.cpp default values: SpeedUp3, SpeedDown1. Scene.h documents stops/second. Retain familiar engine default adaptation before tuning.
parameterBasis.histogramPercentiles: Installed Scene.cpp constructor defaults10/90, rather than guessing from older tooltip recommendations.
parameterBasis.histogramBounds: Review range -4..20 surrounds metering bounds0..16. This bounds histogram sampling and is not a lux measurement.

localSourceEvidence: Engine/Source/Runtime/Engine/Classes/Engine/Scene.h: EAutoExposureMethod; bOverride_AutoExposure*; AutoExposureMinBrightness/MaxBrightness units depend on ExtendDefaultLuminanceRange; SpeedUp/Down units; physical camera only Manual
Engine/Source/Runtime/Engine/Private/Scene.cpp: FPostProcessSettings constructor defaults histogram10/90, speed3/1 and extended brightness/histogram defaults-10..20

Engine/Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/PostProcess/PostProcessEyeAdaptation.cpp: LuminanceMaxFromLensAttenuation returns1 in legacy mode; legacy Min/MaxBrightness used directly; extended values converted fromEV100
Engine/Source/Editor/UnrealEd/Public/FileHelpers.h: EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.NewMapFromTemplate, SaveMap with explicit new asset path
verificationPlan: Refuse PIE, dirty maps, existing pilot path or namespace; validate all reflected properties before mutation.

Hash original Courtyard.umap; snapshot actor names/classes/labels/transforms and SceneComponent transforms/mobility/visibility; mesh/material/collision and all ISM transforms; LightComponentBase inventory including skylight.
Create separate world through native template API and save only unique pilot asset; assert template semantic inventory matches.
Save/reopen pilot; verify selected property values and every other postprocess field via restoring selected fields in an unattached struct copy and comparing export_text.
Verify semantic scene inventory, original map hash, and restore original map view without saving it. Retain failed partial pilot for diagnosis rather than overwriting it.
limitations: Exposure adaptation cannot create missing bounced illumination, correct occlusion, or make a truly unlit space physically bright.
Bright portals may clip and dark interiors may reveal noise or temporal GI instability. No visual improvement has been established.
No new lights, emissive materials, source geometry, source material assignments, project cvars, default startup map, or packaging maps are changed.
Semantic inventory is broad but not a byte-for-byte comparison of every serialized UObject property. Full postprocess settings are compared separately.
Native execution, shader behavior, exterior-to-interior transitions, deep interior readability, return-to-sun adaptation and packaged rendering remain pending.
visualReviewGate: Compare source and pilot at same sunlit exterior and shaded entrance cameras after settling; preserve pale-wall detail.
Walk continuously into interior and return outdoors; inspect adaptation delay, pumping and disorientation while facing both doorway and dark wall.
Review darkest intended public viewing position for believable visibility and temporal noise; do not approve solely because a screenshot is brighter.
If indirect light is absent, diagnose source openings and Lumen behavior separately; this pilot does not authorize invented historic fixtures.
